description: Enhanced boundary coverage for milliseconds-resolution epoch round-tripping (disjoint from native cases). Decoding covers the epoch origin (zero), a negative pre-1970 epoch with a 500ms sub-second borrow, a -1ms epoch landing one millisecond before the origin, and a recent positive epoch; encoding covers the origin, a one-millisecond-past-2000 instant, and a whole-second pre-1970 instant yielding a negative integer epoch.
